description: This file defines the CardMatchManager class, which manages the game state and logic for a memory card matching game, including state transitions for flipping and matching cards, game initialization, and responsive UI considerations.

classes.name: CardMatchManager
classes.description: Game engine class that handles game state, card flipping logic, and game initialization for a memory matching game.

classes.name: FlipResult
classes.description: Sealed class representing possible outcomes of a flip action, including ignoring the flip, flipping a card, a match, or a mismatch.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Starts a new game with a specified number of cards.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores game state from a previously saved state.

methods.name: flip
methods.description: Attempts to flip a card at the specified index, enforcing game rules, and returning the result of the flip.

methods.name: flipBackUnmatchedPair
methods.description: Flips back any currently face-up but mismatched pair of cards.

methods.name: chooseCardCountForWidthPx
methods.description: Decides a suitable number of cards based on available width in pixels, aiming for a responsive layout.

methods.name: chooseColumnCountForWidthPx
methods.description: Decides the number of columns for the game grid based on available width in pixels.

methods.name: maxPairs
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of pairs possible for the current game state.
